002232b5f1f41adf.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每个版本也提供 macOS（一个下载包适用于 Apple Silicon 和 Intel Mac）和 Linux（AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz）版本；它们被标记为实验性，因为它们是新版本且测试较少。请参阅下载。

006bcd211ae86394.source: These pages explain each part of the program. The tutorials walk through the things people do most, one task each.
006bcd211ae86394.text: 这些页面解释了程序的每个部分。教程将引导您完成人们最常做的操作，每个任务一个教程。

015f73be8184c2cb.source: Yes. MDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the file on the server hasn't changed. When a download address has expired, <g1>Refresh download address</g1> lets you give it a fresh one and keep the data. See <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
015f73be8184c2cb.text: 可以。MDM 会实时写入下载进度，因此在连接丢失、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从中断的地方继续。恢复下载前，它会检查服务器上的文件是否已更改。当下载地址过期时，您可以使用<g1>刷新下载地址</g1>来提供新的地址并保留已下载的数据。请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

016a9690b4c55ee5.source: Both are kept in a <x1/> folder in MDM's data folder.
016a9690b4c55ee5.text: 两者都保存在 MDM 数据文件夹中的 <x1/> 文件夹中。

01742a721637a688.source: <g1>Automatically start downloading the following file types</g1> — the file types the browser hands over (and the clipboard picks up). Separate them by spaces; <x2/> matches any characters, as in <x3/>. <g4>Default</g4> puts the original list back.
01742a721637a688.text: <g1>自动下载以下文件类型</g1> — 浏览器移交（和剪贴板获取）的文件类型。用空格分隔；<x2/>匹配任何字符，如<x3/>。<g4>默认</g4>会恢复原始列表。

017e6920369637f6.source: <g1>One look for every kind of control</g1>, in both themes: text boxes, read-only fields, check boxes, buttons, drop-downs, tabs, lists and their headers, popups and progress bars are each drawn one way everywhere (dark mode drew some windows' controls in an older style, with bright borders). A number and its arrows are one box now, as Windows 11's are; text is centred in controls of any height; one blue for selection and focus.
017e6920369637f6.text: <g1>每种控件在两种主题下都具有统一的外观</g1>：文本框、只读字段、复选框、按钮、下拉菜单、选项卡、列表及其标题、弹出窗口和进度条在所有地方都以一种方式绘制（深色模式下某些窗口的控件以旧样式绘制，带有亮边框）。数字及其箭头现在是一个框，就像 Windows 11 那样；文本在任何高度的控件中都居中；选择和焦点使用一种蓝色。

01b91d4b38df7f4a.source: <g1>Launch Mister Download Manager on startup</g1> — start MDM when you sign in to Windows. Off by default. Greyed in a <g2>portable copy</g2>, which writes nothing to the registry.
01b91d4b38df7f4a.text: <g1>启动时运行 Mister Download Manager</g1> — 在您登录 Windows 时启动 MDM。默认关闭。在<g2>便携版</g2>中此项为灰色，因为便携版不会写入注册表。

01bcaeaab78b066e.source: A page address that points at one video inside a playlist or a mix (for example <x1/>) downloads that one video, never the whole list.
01bcaeaab78b066e.text: 指向播放列表或混音中单个视频的页面地址（例如 <x1/>）只会下载该单个视频，而不会下载整个列表。

01c4c1faa63db5e5.source: Add it to the main download queue without starting it.
01c4c1faa63db5e5.text: 将其添加到主下载队列而不立即开始。

01e8f0b4acca66a4.source: <g1>Start Download</g1> (or <g2>Enter</g2>) — download now. The progress window opens.
01e8f0b4acca66a4.text: <g1>开始下载</g1>（或<g2>Enter</g2>） — 立即下载。进度窗口打开。

022606906a44694b.source: <g1>Download Mister Download Manager</g1> and install it; keep <g2>Set up browser integration</g2> ticked.
022606906a44694b.text: <g1>下载 Mister Download Manager</g1>并安装；勾选<g2>设置浏览器集成</g2>。

02371ffa84de243f.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the queue is done. See <g1>Download overnight</g1>.
02371ffa84de243f.text: 可以。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定时间开始，在另一时间停止，甚至在队列完成后关闭或休眠计算机。请参阅<g1>通宵下载</g1>。

0255cefc03d71cf4.source: <g1><g2>Keep some speed for everything else</g2></g1> — cap MDM so browsing and calls stay smooth.
0255cefc03d71cf4.text: <g1><g2>为其他任务保留一些速度</g2></g1> — 限制 MDM 的速度，以便浏览和通话保持流畅。

026a1b767daa1fa2.source: <g1>File name or part of the name</g1> — on by default.
026a1b767daa1fa2.text: <g1>文件名或名称的一部分</g1> — 默认开启。

02a38777a650e8a4.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Video from a page</g3> <g4>Paste a page's address and choose a quality, up to 4K, from YouTube, Vimeo and thousands of other sites.</g4>
02a38777a650e8a4.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>网页视频下载</g3> <g4>粘贴网页地址，从 YouTube、Vimeo 和数千个其他网站选择高达 4K 的视频质量进行下载。</g4>

02a3ebd04f6ae293.source: Each release lists the <g1>SHA-256</g1> checksum of every file in <x2/>. Check your download against it: see <g3>Download</g3>.
02a3ebd04f6ae293.text: 每个版本都列出了 <x2/> 中每个文件的 <g1>SHA-256</g1> 校验和。请对照它检查您的下载：请参阅<g3>下载</g3>。

02b95a4f44948228.source: <g1>Download only what you have the right to.</g1> You are responsible for what you download and share.
02b95a4f44948228.text: <g1>只下载您有权下载的内容。</g1>您对您下载和分享的内容负责。

02ca3f873396cdab.source: How to help Mister Download Manager: report bugs, fix translations, build it from source and send pull requests. The checks CI runs and the project's rules.
02ca3f873396cdab.text: 如何帮助 Mister Download Manager：报告错误、修复翻译、从源代码构建并发送拉取请求。CI 运行的检查和项目规则。

02e10cd2e08b346c.source: MDM starts its torrent engine the first time you add a torrent. If you never use torrents, it never listens for peers.
02e10cd2e08b346c.text: MDM 在您第一次添加种子时启动其种子引擎。如果您从不使用种子，它就永远不会监听对等方。

02f824962fd84248.source: This cap is shared by every download, however many run at once. It works on its own; you don't need to turn the Speed Limiter on.
02f824962fd84248.text: 无论同时运行多少个下载，此限制都由所有下载共享。它独立工作；您无需开启速度限制器。

03069bf346ba733c.source: <g1>Help → About Mister Download Manager</g1> shows the version you have.
03069bf346ba733c.text: <g1>帮助 → 关于 Mister Download Manager</g1>显示你拥有的版本。

031da5c20d1881e4.text: 计划程序能做的所有事情 →

0364c0cf3df3d7e2.source: Select the download and click <g1>Resume</g1>. Many errors are a server or connection having a bad moment.
0364c0cf3df3d7e2.text: 选择下载并点击<g1>恢复</g1>。许多错误是服务器或连接暂时出现问题。

03eaf59587da32f8.source: Answers about Mister Download Manager: is it free, is it safe, how it compares with IDM, browsers, videos, torrents, speed, Mac and Linux, and more.
03eaf59587da32f8.text: 关于 Mister Download Manager 的解答：它是否免费、是否安全、与 IDM 的比较、浏览器、视频、种子、速度、Mac 和 Linux 等。

047d41a834df5979.source: Free and open source. The interface you already know, a faster engine underneath, torrents and video built in.
047d41a834df5979.text: 免费开源。您已熟悉的界面，更快的底层引擎，内置种子下载和视频下载功能。

0533acda9da6cbfb.source: <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> filled the form's System and Installed with only for a moment; they stay filled now.
0533acda9da6cbfb.text: 现在，<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1> 填写的表单中的“系统”和“已安装”信息会一直保留，而不会只显示一小会儿。

053b48e80f60c390.source: <g1>Ignore file modification time changes when resuming a download</g1> — for servers that report a new date for the same file each time. Without it, such a server makes every resume start over.
053b48e80f60c390.text: <g1>恢复下载时忽略文件修改时间更改</g1> — 适用于每次都为同一文件报告新日期的服务器。如果没有此选项，此类服务器会使每次恢复都重新开始。

0545f90df5da9852.source: Can I limit the download speed? — Mister Download Manager
0545f90df5da9852.text: 我可以限制下载速度吗？— Mister Download Manager

05496369e6596ec5.source: Yes. MDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the file on the server hasn't changed. When a download address has expired, Refresh download address lets you give it a fresh one and keep the data. See Resume a broken download.
05496369e6596ec5.text: 是。MDM 会实时记录下载进度，因此在连接中断、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从停止的地方继续下载。恢复下载前，它会检查服务器上的文件是否发生变化。当下载地址过期时，刷新下载地址 功能可让您提供新的地址并保留现有数据。请参阅恢复中断的下载。

056973ea0bc40de4.source: Use GitHub's private <g1><g2>Report a vulnerability</g2></g1> form. Only the maintainers can read it. Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version you used (<g3>Help → About</g3> shows it). Please don't open a public issue for security problems.
056973ea0bc40de4.text: 请使用 GitHub 的私有<g1><g2>报告漏洞</g2></g1>表单。只有维护者才能阅读。请说明您发现了什么、如何重现以及您使用的版本（<g3>帮助 → 关于</g3>中显示）。请不要为安全问题公开提交问题。

0570989b9bf67a64.source: Sites change often, and a newer yt-dlp usually fixes it. MDM doesn't update yt-dlp on its own yet. To get the newest one: quit MDM (<g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>), delete the <x2/> folder in MDM's data folder (<x3/>, or the <x4/> folder of a portable copy), start MDM, open the video window and click <g5>Install yt-dlp</g5>.
0570989b9bf67a64.text: 网站经常变化，更新的 yt-dlp 通常可以解决问题。MDM 尚未自动更新 yt-dlp。要获取最新版本：退出 MDM（<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>），删除 MDM 数据文件夹中的 <x2/> 文件夹（<x3/>，或便携版副本的 <x4/> 文件夹），启动 MDM，打开视频窗口并点击<g5>安装 yt-dlp</g5>。

05ae27da0376b80e.text: 适用于 Debian 和 Ubuntu 的 <g1>.deb</g1>，适用于 Fedora 的 <g2>.rpm</g2>

05e4107afbf16316.source: Open it with <g1>Scheduler</g1> on the toolbar or <g2>Downloads → Scheduler</g2>. Right-clicking a queue and choosing <g3>Schedule</g3> or <g4>Edit queue</g4> opens it on that queue.
05e4107afbf16316.text: 通过工具栏上的<g1>计划程序</g1>或<g2>下载 → 计划程序</g2>打开它。右键点击一个队列并选择<g3>计划</g3>或<g4>编辑队列</g4>会在该队列上打开它。

05e98a5438868ee9.source: The other buttons copy the report, open its folder, or start MDM again.
05e98a5438868ee9.text: 其他按钮会复制报告、打开其文件夹或再次启动 MDM。

05f8c91edd2041dd.source: Under <g1>Add to queue</g1>, pick <g2>Main download queue</g2>. Leave <g3>Start the queue now</g3> unticked. Click <g4>OK</g4>.
05f8c91edd2041dd.text: 在<g1>添加到队列</g1>下，选择<g2>主下载队列</g2>。不要勾选<g3>立即启动队列</g3>。点击<g4>确定</g4>。

062e786e54295c85.source: We'd rather you knew. IDM has a site grabber for whole websites, store-listed browser extensions, and many years of polish and compatibility fixes. MDM is new; if something you rely on is missing, <g1>ask for it</g1>.
062e786e54295c85.text: 我们希望您了解。IDM 拥有用于抓取整个网站的网站抓取器、应用商店上架的浏览器扩展程序，以及多年的完善和兼容性修复。MDM 是新项目；如果您依赖的某些功能缺失，请<g1>提出需求</g1>。

068929e04a8d8a6b.text: 进度窗口显示下载情况：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的状态。

06eeabbea1b11ae5.source: Uninstall MDM from Windows <g1>Settings → Apps</g1>. The uninstaller asks whether to delete your download list and settings too. Your downloaded files are never touched.
06eeabbea1b11ae5.text: 从 Windows <g1>设置 → 应用</g1>中卸载 MDM。卸载程序会询问是否也删除您的下载列表和设置。您的下载文件永远不会被触及。

06f2b21b4750b749.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？

06fc1bc448892347.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. MDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections, and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See Connections and speed.
06fc1bc448892347.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。MDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多可达 32 个连接，并持续重新分配：当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅“连接和速度”。

070c8fa6ee24507e.source: Download <g1>setup.exe</g1> above and run it. Windows may ask whether to allow it: the installer isn't code-signed yet, so choose <g2>More info → Run anyway</g2>.
070c8fa6ee24507e.text: 下载上方的<g1>setup.exe</g1>并运行。Windows 可能会询问是否允许运行：安装程序尚未进行代码签名，因此请选择<g2>更多信息 → 仍然运行</g2>。

072428c8bd6ba91a.source: When the limit is reached, MDM stops downloading. New downloads show <g1>Waiting: the download limit is reached (Scheduler)</g1>. Everything resumes on its own when the period is over. <g2>Show warning before stopping downloads</g2> tells you when this happens and when downloads will go on.
072428c8bd6ba91a.text: 达到限制后，MDM 会停止下载。新的下载会显示<g1>等待: 已达到下载限制（计划程序）</g1>。当时间段结束后，所有下载都会自动恢复。<g2>停止下载前显示警告</g2>会在发生此情况以及下载何时继续时通知您。

07367459e6405a5a.source: <g1>Screen readers</g1> (Narrator, NVDA): every window, dialogs and menus included, now tells them what each control is, its name and its state; the download list reads each download.
07367459e6405a5a.text: <g1>屏幕阅读器</g1>（讲述人、NVDA）：现在每个窗口、对话框和菜单都包含在内，告知它们每个控件是什么、其名称和状态；下载列表会读取每个下载。

076e2912a172401a.text: 第 13 代英特尔(R) 酷睿(TM) i5-13400F，63.8 GB 内存，Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0。labserver（此仓库），127.0.0.1:8097，生成内容。两者均使用默认设置：8 个连接。

07f366ab526e100d.source: Check that there is a <x1/> folder next to <x2/>. That folder is what makes MDM portable. Don't delete it.
07f366ab526e100d.text: 检查<x2/>旁边是否有<x1/>文件夹。这个文件夹使 MDM 成为便携版。请勿删除它。

08e0c4ded815bc81.text: MDM 支持 <x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和 <x6/> 地址。其他任何地址都会显示<g7>地址无效</g7>。

11c54a9841b75a9b.source: <g1>Fairness.</g1> The apps alternate, IDM first on even runs and MDM first on odd ones, so drift on the machine hits both. One warm-up run each is discarded. Failed runs are counted, not dropped. Before every run the harness waits until the loopback is quiet: against a server that refuses extra connections IDM retries about 250 times a second, leaving thousands of closed sockets for half a minute; without the wait, whichever app ran next was timed on that backlog.
11c54a9841b75a9b.text: <g1>公平性。</g1> 应用程序交替运行，IDM 在偶数次运行中优先，MDM 在奇数次运行中优先，因此机器上的漂移会同时影响两者。每次运行一次热身运行，结果被丢弃。失败的运行会被计数，而不是丢弃。在每次运行之前，测试工具会等待直到回环链路安静：对于拒绝额外连接的服务器，IDM 每秒重试约 250 次，留下数千个关闭的套接字半分钟；如果没有等待，接下来运行的应用程序将在该积压上计时。

178c8da6e827d8a3.source: Leave MDM running. Closing the main window is fine: MDM keeps going in the tray. Don't use <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>.
178c8da6e827d8a3.text: 让 MDM 保持运行。关闭主窗口没关系：MDM 会在系统托盘中继续运行。不要使用<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>。

18bca0e419aafc22.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 的<g1>浏览器集成</g1>（Firefox 正在测试中）：下载会将其 Cookie 和引用页移交给 MDM，右键单击<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g2>，以及在任何页面视频上方显示<g3>下载视频</g3>按钮，该按钮可以沿视频边缘拖动、在视频或网站上隐藏，或在选项中关闭。

1aafdbaf510c3af8.text: <g1>永久免费。</g1> 没有试用期，没有许可证密钥，没有广告。GNU GPL 保证它始终免费。

1ae1f6b28d64deef.source: The browser extension comes with the app and as its own download for <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1> and <g2>Firefox</g2>. Store listings are on the way. Every file is built from the public source by GitHub Actions and listed with its SHA-256 checksum.

1b0e944da20951df.text: 比 IDM 更快。精确到毫秒。

1b2880e6f949c293.text: <g1>完成后打开以下文件</g1> — 例如声音、脚本或程序。<g2>...</g2>用于选择文件。

1b3efe7b98d2c2da.text: 在列表或下拉列表中，跳转到以该字母开头的项目

1b435f0f6139d174.text: 您可以根据<g1>GNU GPL 第 3 版</g1>使用、复制、修改和分享 Mister Download Manager。

1b5f580bc58179ec.source: The download list, settings, helpers for video (yt-dlp, ffmpeg) and torrent data are kept in <x1/>, not in your Windows profile.
1b5f580bc58179ec.text: 下载列表、设置、视频助手（yt-dlp、ffmpeg）和种子数据都保存在 <x1/> 中，而不是您的 Windows 配置文件中。

1b8598b5d096034c.source: Its permissions, and why: <g1>downloads</g1> to see and hand over downloads; <g2>cookies</g2> so signed-in downloads work in MDM; <g3>nativeMessaging</g3> to talk to MDM; <g4>contextMenus</g4> for the right-click item; <g5>storage</g5> for its settings; access to all sites because downloads and videos can come from any site.
1b8598b5d096034c.text: 其权限以及原因：<g1>下载</g1>用于查看和移交下载；<g2>cookie</g2>用于使登录下载在 MDM 中工作；<g3>nativeMessaging</g3>用于与 MDM 通信；<g4>contextMenus</g4>用于右键菜单项；<g5>storage</g5>用于其设置；访问所有站点是因为下载和视频可以来自任何站点。

1b8ba08ddbbd4d39.source: Show a dialog and ask what to do.
1b8ba08ddbbd4d39.text: 显示对话框并询问如何操作。

1b95b890c71da1b4.source: How it works: a second copy of MDM, the <g1>monitor</g1>, starts beside it with <x2/>. The crash code lives in <x3/> and <x4/>.
1b95b890c71da1b4.text: 工作原理：MDM 的第二个副本，即<g1>监视器</g1>，与它一起通过<x2/>启动。崩溃代码位于<x3/>和<x4/>中。

1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left, as Windows does for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable.
1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.text: 在阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语中，整个窗口是镜像的：菜单、工具栏和类别从右到左排列，就像 Windows 对这些语言所做的那样。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中保持其自身方向，以便保持可读性。

1bdc6a06e3384bd1.text: <g1>任务</g1> — 添加下载、种子、批量下载和视频；显示拖放目标；导入和导出列表；退出。

1be93bd020009908.text: <g1>键盘焦点丢失</g1>：当按钮变灰或 Escape 键关闭下拉菜单时，Tab 键会从窗口顶部重新开始。现在它会像 Windows 中一样继续移动或返回。

1c6bf762506d348a.text: MDM 附带一个 <g1>MCP</g1> 服务器 <x2/>，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 等）可以与您正在运行的 MDM 中的下载协同工作。您可以用自己的话提问：

1ca5420546545830.source: <g1>Force processes to terminate</g1> closes programs that would otherwise hold Windows up.
1ca5420546545830.text: <g1>强制终止进程</g1>会关闭那些可能导致 Windows 无法正常关闭的程序。

1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> shows the file's name, its size and where it will be saved. The folder depends on the file's type: a ZIP goes to <x2/>, a video to <x3/>, and so on. Change the folder or the category if you like.
1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>显示文件名、大小以及保存位置。文件夹取决于文件类型：ZIP 文件到<x2/>，视频文件到<x3/>，依此类推。您可以更改文件夹或类别。

1ccc70fb4aa18b18.source: MDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11. Builds for macOS and Linux are new: see <g1>On a Mac or Linux</g1>.
1ccc70fb4aa18b18.text: MDM 运行于 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11。macOS 和 Linux 版本是新推出的：请参阅<g1>在 Mac 或 Linux 上</g1>。

1d26bf9aebfa246c.source: The main window in Arabic, laid out right to left.

1d698c89212c8b9b.text: 每次运行期间，各应用使用的 CPU 时间中位数及其内存峰值。MDM 使用 GPU 绘制窗口，这比 IDM 的经典 Windows 控件占用更多内存。

1da156143837aec9.source: Click <g1>Add Torrent</g1> on the toolbar to choose a <x2/> file. Or click the arrow next to it and choose <g3>Open torrent file...</g3> or <g4>Add magnet link...</g4> (also under <g5>Tasks</g5>).
1da156143837aec9.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>来选择一个 <x2/> 文件。或者点击旁边的箭头，选择<g3>打开 torrent 文件...</g3>或<g4>添加磁力链接...</g4>（也在<g5>任务</g5>下）。

1db710a3a79cb703.source: <g1>Show download complete dialog</g1> — show <g2>Download complete</g2> when a file finishes.
1db710a3a79cb703.text: <g1>显示下载完成对话框</g1> — 文件完成时显示<g2>下载完成</g2>。

1dd3fad91652b5ff.source: Pick what the setup should do: - <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>Open .torrent files and magnet links with Mister Download Manager</g2> - <g3>Start Mister Download Manager when Windows starts</g3> - <g4>Create a desktop shortcut</g4> (off unless you tick it)
1dd3fad91652b5ff.text: 选择安装程序应执行的操作：- <g1>设置浏览器集成 (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 打开 .torrent 文件和磁力链接</g2> - <g3>Windows 启动时启动 Mister Download Manager</g3> - <g4>创建桌面快捷方式</g4>（默认关闭，除非您勾选）

1e4861cc4f32a384.text: <g1>用户看到的所有文本都通过<x2/></g1>（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>）；添加后，运行<x7/>。句子中的数据（文件名、地址、大小）通过<x8/>或<x9/>输入，以便在从右到左的语言中正确显示。

1e7024dcce490c17.text: 下载列表 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

1e85323c7843fa8c.text: 填写<g1>每 [H] 小时下载不超过 [N] MB</g1>。默认设置为每 5 小时 200 MB。

1f65e62d97ecd48e.source: Mister Download Manager's main window in day mode: web and torrent downloads in one list, with categories, sizes, progress, speeds and dates.
1f65e62d97ecd48e.text: Mister Download Manager 白天模式主窗口：网页和种子下载在一个列表中，显示类别、大小、进度、速度和日期。

1f6d9db77baccf7e.source: Click <g1>Download Now</g1>, or <g2>Later</g2> to add it to the list without starting.
1f6d9db77baccf7e.text: 点击<g1>立即下载</g1>，或点击<g2>稍后</g2>将其添加到列表而不开始下载。

1f97ee3107818c42.text: 速度限制器和连接详情 →

1f98be990d8acb5c.source: A torrent's progress window on its Pieces tab: a square for each piece, filled once it's here.
1f98be990d8acb5c.text: 种子下载进度窗口的“分块”选项卡：每个分块一个方块，下载完成后填充。

1fa9954a1941617d.source: MDM opens the web page the link came from (when it knows it), and the download's <g1>File Properties</g1>.
1fa9954a1941617d.text: MDM 会打开链接来源的网页（如果它知道），以及下载的<g1>文件属性</g1>。

1fd04f332635d14c.source: Look at <g1>Resume capability</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts. MDM then uses one connection, and a download that stops has to start over. For such servers, avoid stopping the download, and avoid a very low speed limit, which can make the server drop the connection.
1fd04f332635d14c.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>恢复功能</g1>。<g2>否</g2>表示服务器无法分段发送文件。MDM 此时会使用一个连接，并且停止的下载必须重新开始。对于此类服务器，请避免停止下载，并避免设置过低的限速，这可能导致服务器断开连接。

20504fb177eb6cfc.source: To keep a site's downloads in the browser, add the site to <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1>. To keep a file type in the browser, take it off the file types list.
20504fb177eb6cfc.text: 要将网站的下载保留在浏览器中，请将该网站添加到<g1>不要从以下网站自动开始下载</g1>。要将文件类型保留在浏览器中，请将其从文件类型列表中删除。

2074b7c27e1d1876.text: 选择 MDM 文件夹内的<x1/>文件夹。如果您为自己安装了 MDM，路径是<x2/>；您可以将该路径粘贴到文件夹框中。

20802419a2c5daee.text: — 隐式 FTPS，端口 990，除非地址中另有指定。

20bfe390ea3f70e6.source: Can I use it without installing it?
20bfe390ea3f70e6.text: 我可以不安装就使用它吗？

20f9ef471d29f4c4.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>. MDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.

21bc1db419022796.source: <g1>Statcounter</g1> counts visits so we know which pages people read and where they come from. Its script records the page you open, the page that linked to it, your browser, system and screen size, and your approximate location from your IP address, and sets a cookie to tell new visitors from returning ones. We see these as statistics in Statcounter's dashboard; we don't use them to identify you, and we don't sell or share them. See <g2>Statcounter's privacy policy</g2>. Blocking cookies or scripts for statcounter.com in your browser, or a content blocker, keeps you out of the count; the site works the same.
21bc1db419022796.text: <g1>Statcounter</g1> 统计访问量，以便我们了解人们阅读了哪些页面以及他们来自何处。其脚本会记录您打开的页面、链接到该页面的页面、您的浏览器、系统和屏幕尺寸，以及根据您的 IP 地址推断的大致位置，并设置一个 Cookie 来区分新访客和回访者。我们在 Statcounter 的控制面板中将这些信息视为统计数据；我们不会使用它们来识别您的身份，也不会出售或分享它们。请参阅 <g2>Statcounter 的隐私政策</g2>。在您的浏览器中阻止 statcounter.com 的 Cookie 或脚本，或使用内容拦截器，可以使您不被计入统计；网站功能保持不变。

3bd468019bd25247.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. MDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections, and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See <g1>Connections and speed</g1>.
3bd468019bd25247.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。MDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接，并持续重新分割：当一个连接完成其部分时，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖慢整个过程。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

3f66be3de33c7d79.source: Some sites, YouTube among them, send each viewer to a nearby video server, sometimes one inside the internet provider's own network. If that server can't be reached from your connection, a browser quietly switches to another one, but yt-dlp on its own would give up. Before each video download MDM checks the servers in the video's links and, if one doesn't answer, switches to the next one the site lists. The download's log says when this happens.
3f66be3de33c7d79.text: 一些网站，包括 YouTube，会将每个观看者发送到附近的视频服务器，有时是互联网提供商自己网络中的服务器。如果您的连接无法访问该服务器，浏览器会悄悄切换到另一个服务器，但 yt-dlp 自己会放弃。在每次视频下载之前，MDM 会检查视频链接中的服务器，如果一个服务器没有响应，则切换到网站列出的下一个服务器。下载日志会显示何时发生这种情况。

462b4ea88323a117.text: 欢迎提交错误报告、想法、翻译修正和拉取请求。所有活动都在<g1>GitHub</g1>上公开进行。

There, MDM connects itself to Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi and Firefox, has its tray icon, follows the system's light or dark look and uses the system's fonts and ffmpeg. 4755b8b48f69ec2a.text: 从“开始”菜单启动 Mister Download Manager，然后<g1>下载您的第一个文件</g1>。

479315841001935e.text: <g1><x2/></g1>，一个单独的命令行工具：在终端中下载文件、视频和种子，显示进度，无需应用程序。

47c3075afae12dd9.source: MDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download MDM only from this site or the project's GitHub releases.
47c3075afae12dd9.text: MDM 不含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑优惠或跟踪。它的全部源代码都是公开的，任何人都可以检查它的功能，并且每个版本都是由 GitHub 的服务器从该代码构建的，构建过程可以被检查。它为视频下载而获取的辅助程序在运行前会经过验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。请仅从本网站或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 MDM。

482710e14ce3ef8f.source: You don't need to start MDM first: if it isn't running, it starts by itself.
482710e14ce3ef8f.text: 您无需先启动 MDM：如果它没有运行，它会自行启动。

48ca7e0fd6df660f.source: <g1>Downloaded file names are cleaned</g1> before they become paths, so a server can't write outside the folder you chose.
48ca7e0fd6df660f.text: <g1>下载的文件名在成为路径之前会进行清理</g1>，因此服务器无法在您选择的文件夹之外写入。

497c203588092008.text: 当下载在队列中时，显示一个队列图标。

49a1f458cccd4ce1.source: <g1>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g1> is a free, open-source download manager for Windows 10 and 11, with experimental builds for macOS and Linux. It looks and works like Internet Download Manager (IDM), but it is free (GPL-3.0), downloaded a 1 GiB file 5.4 times faster than IDM 6.42 in our published benchmark, and also downloads torrents, magnet links and videos from web pages. A browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox hands downloads to it.
49a1f458cccd4ce1.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g1> 是一款免费、开源的下载管理器，适用于 Windows 10 和 11，并提供 macOS 和 Linux 的实验性版本。它的外观和功能类似于 Internet Download Manager (IDM)，但它是免费的 (GPL-3.0)，在我们发布的基准测试中，下载 1 GiB 文件比 IDM 6.42 快 5.4 倍，并且还支持下载种子、磁力链接和网页视频。适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的浏览器扩展程序可将下载任务交给它。

49b4a645676f1c52.source: Short version: the Mister Download Manager app and its browser extension don't collect anything about you. No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, no ads. This website counts its visits with Statcounter.
49b4a645676f1c52.text: 简短版本：Mister Download Manager 应用及其浏览器扩展程序不收集您的任何信息。没有账户、没有分析、没有遥测、没有广告。本网站使用 Statcounter 统计访问量。

4bf5f0c33ed7fbad.source: Really free, with no time limit or paid edition. <g1>More</g1>
4bf5f0c33ed7fbad.text: 真正免费，没有时间限制，也没有付费版。<g1>更多</g1>

4ceca71bcfd7f0a8.text: 双击列表中的种子以打开其进度窗口。除了常规状态外，种子的窗口有五个选项卡：

4d35cd399872baf1.text: 打开所选下载（双击操作遵循右键单击 → <g1>双击时</g1> 的设置）

4d5e2be36abbc65b.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>86 languages, right to left too</g3> <g4>It speaks your computer's language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu lay out right to left.</g4>
4d5e2be36abbc65b.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>86 种语言，支持从右到左</g3> <g4>它会说您电脑的语言。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语和乌尔都语支持从右到左排版。</g4>

4d7daf5f5a647783.text: 双击下载，打开其进度窗口。

4d895f12e00559ae.text: 它能从 Netflix 或其他付费流媒体服务下载吗？

4dad09a9ad62a54a.source: Many sites hand out links that only work for a while, or only while you are signed in. Resuming then fails, because the old address no longer answers.
4dad09a9ad62a54a.text: 许多网站提供的链接只在一段时间内有效，或者只在您登录时有效。此时恢复会失败，因为旧地址不再响应。

4dbf5f3368111d27.text: 免费开源。安装它，点击链接，查看每个连接的工作情况。

4dd744e98a23c84f.source: MDM can download and run third-party tools at your request: <g1>yt-dlp</g1> for video pages and <g2>ffmpeg</g2> for merging video and sound. They come from their developers' official releases, are checked before they run, and are governed by their own licences (yt-dlp: Unlicense; ffmpeg: LGPL or GPL, depending on the build). The libraries built into MDM and their licences are listed on the <g3>License</g3> page. Websites and services you download from are governed by their own terms.
4dd744e98a23c84f.text: MDM 可以根据您的请求下载并运行第三方工具：用于视频页面的 <g1>yt-dlp</g1> 和用于合并视频和音频的 <g2>ffmpeg</g2>。它们来自其开发者的官方发布版本，在运行前经过检查，并受其各自许可的约束（yt-dlp：Unlicense；ffmpeg：LGPL 或 GPL，取决于构建版本）。MDM 内置的库及其许可列在<g3>许可</g3>页面上。您下载的网站和服务受其各自条款的约束。

4de971bbe1263ef0.text: 教程：在 U盘上携带 MDM →

4e0dc326dff9f5b7.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to the download. Right-click the download, choose <g1>Verify checksum...</g1> and paste it. MDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32. A finished file is checked at once; an unfinished one is checked when its download ends. MDM then says <g2>The file matches</g2> or <g3>The file does NOT match</g3>.
4e0dc326dff9f5b7.text: 许多网站在下载旁边发布校验和。右键单击下载，选择<g1>验证校验和...</g1>并粘贴。MDM 读取 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32。已完成的文件会立即检查；未完成的文件会在下载结束时检查。MDM 随后会显示<g2>文件匹配</g2>或<g3>文件不匹配</g3>。

4e3e7d596fa947ef.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> (the Video category's folder by default) and <g2>File name</g2>, which comes from the video's title.
4e3e7d596fa947ef.text: 检查<g1>保存到</g1>（默认为视频类别的文件夹）和<g2>文件名</g2>，文件名来自视频标题。

4f4c098768b05078.source: Everything can be done from the keyboard, and MDM works with screen readers (such as Narrator and NVDA on Windows): its windows, dialogs and menus tell them what each control is and its state, and the download list reads each download's name, status and size.
4f4c098768b05078.text: 所有操作都可以通过键盘完成，MDM 支持屏幕阅读器（例如 Windows 上的讲述人 (Narrator) 和 NVDA）：其窗口、对话框和菜单会告知屏幕阅读器每个控件的名称和状态，下载列表会朗读每个下载的名称、状态和大小。

4fdcd2fa8811b894.source: MDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the MDM on this computer, over the token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes to its own AI service: when it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the automation API off, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
4fdcd2fa8811b894.text: MDM 本身仍然不会向任何地方发送任何内容：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 MDM 通信。但助手读取的内容会传递给其自身的 AI 服务：当它列出您的下载内容时，其文件名、地址和文件夹会根据该服务的隐私条款发送到该服务。当您不希望这样时，请关闭自动化 API，或从助手中删除服务器。

5730437f2b40d7c8.text: 你也可以<g1>自行打开表单</g1>；它会要求相同的详细信息。

63d0ba3e76606052.source: No. MDM is an independent program written from scratch in Rust, with no connection to Tonec Inc., the makers of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It contains none of IDM's code or artwork. Its windows are laid out the way IDM users expect, so you can switch without learning anything new — and because MDM is free, there is nothing to crack. Please don't download "cracked" download managers: they are a common way to spread malware.
63d0ba3e76606052.text: 不是。MDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的开发商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它不包含 IDM 的任何代码或美术作品。它的窗口布局符合 IDM 用户的习惯，因此您可以无需学习新知识即可切换使用——而且由于 MDM 是免费的，所以无需破解。请不要下载“破解版”下载管理器：它们是传播恶意软件的常见方式。

6ab8b11bc61aa33f.source: <g1>Download Later</g1> puts the download in a queue instead of starting it. By default MDM asks which one: pick the queue under <g2>Add to queue</g2>, and tick <g3>Start the queue now</g3> if you want it to run straight away. <g4>Cancel</g4> leaves the download in the list, in no queue.
6ab8b11bc61aa33f.text: <g1>稍后下载</g1>会将下载放入队列，而不是立即开始。默认情况下，MDM 会询问要放入哪个队列：在<g2>添加到队列</g2>下选择队列，如果您希望它立即运行，请勾选<g3>立即启动队列</g3>。<g4>取消</g4>会将下载留在列表中，不放入任何队列。

6ac91a3d3467060e.source: Right-click a link, a video, a sound or a picture and choose <g1>Download with Mister Download Manager</g1>. MDM downloads it whatever its type: you asked for it, so the file types list and the excluded sites don't apply here (they only decide which downloads MDM takes over by itself).

6add747d087cfb25.source: Adds an http, https, ftp or ftps address and starts it, or only queues it. It can say which folder and file name to use. A magnet link opens <g1>Add torrent</g1> in MDM, for you to choose the files.
6add747d087cfb25.text: 添加 http、https、ftp 或 ftps 地址并开始下载，或者只将其排队。它可以指定要使用的文件夹和文件名。磁力链接会在 MDM 中打开<g1>添加种子</g1>，供您选择文件。

6b0ef8e85512f319.source: Runs the new setup without its windows. An installation for all users asks for the administrator's permission.
6b0ef8e85512f319.text: 运行新的安装程序，不显示其窗口。所有用户的安装需要管理员权限。

6b1f32baf0de106c.source: <g1><g2>Portable mode</g2></g1> — run MDM from a folder or a USB stick without installing it.

6b6f3ca5090700e9.source: <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> opens GitHub's new bug report form with your MDM version, your system and its version, how MDM was installed and its language filled in. Every report now says which system and version it comes from.
6b6f3ca5090700e9.text: <g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1> 现在会打开 GitHub 的新错误报告表单，并自动填写您的 MDM 版本、系统及其版本、MDM 的安装方式和语言。现在，每份报告都会说明它来自哪个系统和版本。

6b7f693b4a3ad080.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Torrents, built in</g3> <g4>Magnet links and .torrent files in the same list. Pick the files you want, then watch the swarm piece by piece.</g4>

Click <g3>Yes, download them (recommended)</g3> and they download in the background, about 100 MB, once. <g4>Not now</g4> leaves them for later: the video window offers them when you first need them. More in <g5>Videos</g5>.

(You can also open it with <g5>Tasks → Download video from a page...</g5>, paste the address and click <g6>Look up</g6>.)

787aa2d926139bb5.source: <g1>Crash reports.</g1> If MDM closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a report window opens. It shows what happened and where in MDM's code, lets you read the whole report, and <g2>Send on GitHub</g2> opens a crash report form in your browser, filled in. Nothing is sent by itself. When the same problem was already reported, it takes you to that issue instead. A frozen MDM can be ended and restarted from there. Reports leave out your download addresses and file names. See <g3>Crash reports</g3>.
787aa2d926139bb5.text: <g1>崩溃报告。</g1> 如果 MDM 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开一个报告窗口。它会显示 MDM 代码中发生的问题和位置，让您阅读完整的报告，并且<g2>在 GitHub 上发送</g2>会在您的浏览器中打开一个已填写的崩溃报告表单。不会自动发送任何内容。如果相同问题已报告，它会带您到该问题。冻结的 MDM 可以从那里结束并重新启动。报告会省略您的下载地址和文件名。请参阅<g3>崩溃报告</g3>。

a02445ca780f3ef8.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> holds the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turns menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x2/> (open, closed, done with a value). Windows-only calls are confined to <x3/> and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x4/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x5/>).
a02445ca780f3ef8.text: 一个绘制到固定像素坐标的 egui 窗口，加上每个对话框一个即时视口。<x1/> 保存状态（下载、队列、设置、列表选择）并将菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是自己的模块，并返回一个 <x2/>（打开、关闭、带值完成）。仅限 Windows 的调用限制在 <x3/> 中，其 Linux 和 macOS 对应项限制在 <x4/> 中（从会话、浏览器主机、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序开始）；所有其他文件都是安全的、可移植的 Rust。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig（<x5/>）。

d1432f447b205626.source: <g1>Catching problems.</g1> When MDM crashes (a Windows exception, a signal on Linux, a Mach exception on macOS), panics, or freezes, it asks the monitor for a dump. A freeze is a frame of the window running more than 8 s, seen by a watchdog thread that ignores time spent asleep. The monitor then writes a <g2>minidump</g2> of every thread from outside, through <x3/> and <x4/>. A crashed process never writes its own dump, which is how Firefox, Crashpad and Sentry do it too.
d1432f447b205626.text: <g1>捕获问题。</g1>当 MDM 崩溃（Windows 异常、Linux 上的信号、macOS 上的 Mach 异常）、恐慌或冻结时，它会向监视器请求转储。冻结是指窗口运行超过 8 秒的帧，由一个忽略休眠时间的看门狗线程检测到。然后，监视器通过<x3/>和<x4/>从外部写入每个线程的<g2>minidump</g2>。崩溃的进程从不写入自己的转储，Firefox、Crashpad 和 Sentry 也是这样做的。

ef0fe27d24f63c0a.source: <g1>Timing.</g1> End to end: from issuing the command to the finished file under its final name, polled every millisecond on a monotonic clock. MDM renames its finished file into place; IDM creates the final file early and fills it, so for IDM the moment it reaches full size counts. Transfer: the server's first request to its last byte, read on the same clock through a calibration request before each run.
ef0fe27d24f63c0a.text: <g1>计时。</g1> 端到端：从发出命令到文件以最终名称完成，在单调时钟上每毫秒轮询一次。MDM 将完成的文件重命名到位；IDM 提前创建最终文件并填充它，因此对于 IDM，达到完整大小的时刻即为完成。传输：服务器的第一个请求到最后一个字节，在每次运行前通过校准请求在同一时钟上读取。
